text:
Chris (CEO): Quick cornerstones update — three priorities this week: 1) Private GA readiness (security checklist, docs, perf gating); 2) reduce p95 inference tail by 20% (runtime/infra); 3) hit $0.40/1k token target for hosted cost play. Readouts Fri 10:00am PT in #exec-brief. Ask: each team lead, post one measurable you can move this week.

Marta (VP Product): Private GA checklist in drive: https://drive.redwood.com/priv_ga_checklist — need SMEs for KMS and compliance run. @Lena can you lead the compliance dry run?

Lena (Head of Security): Yes. Scheduling a 60m run Wed 2pm PT and will invite security + infra. Need list of customer export controls to validate.

Jordan (Eng SRE): Runtime plan: toggle continuous batching, warm KV cache on startup, and tweak scheduler. PR #4583 exposes batching knob — rolling to staging now.

Jordan (Eng SRE): Quick validation curl for staging latency:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"latency test"}'
```

Marta (VP Product): We'll gate any model-variant swaps with eval suite "cornerstone-smoke" (docs linked). No regressions allowed for GA.

Sam (VP Eng): Routing, runtime, cache teams — post a 1-line update in this thread by EOD Tue. We'll consolidate for Fri readout.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime/v1.14 -> staging at 2024-05-22T09:30Z :rocket:

Priya (Data & Ops): Cost sims: caching + quantization gets us to ~ $0.43/1k tokens conservatively. Will share breakdown by EOD.

Jordan (Eng SRE): Rolling to canary now; monitoring p50/p95 and token-cost delta.

Chris (CEO): Two asks again: 1) team leads post single measurable by EOD Tue, 2) be ready with a 3-slide readout Fri (metrics, risk, blockers). Bring a short backup if p95 misses.

Lena (Head of Security): Note: Private GA docs must include customer key rotation steps. Adding to checklist.

Sam (VP Eng): Noted. @Marta docs signoff?

Marta (VP Product): Docs team will have first pass Wed EOD.

Chris (CEO): Also—good momentum: 10k dev signups last week, nice work :tada:

Sam (VP Eng): Quick budget flag: need extra dedicated GPUs for private GA validation; emailing finance.

Priya (Data & Ops): I'll model budget impact and share with finance.

Chris (CEO): Thanks all. See the Fri readout. End.
